scenes.name: SIX TWO FOUR
lines: Nineteen integer points sit on a sphere of squared radius eight hundred sixty-seven.
十九个非负整点，落在平方半径 867 的球面上。
Lift them to twenty-five states, and compare along the shortest chords, twice, in order.
把它们提升为二十五态，沿最短弦作两次有序比较。
How many distinct comparison channels appear? Exactly six hundred twenty-four.
能出现多少条不同的比较通道？恰好 624 条。

scenes.name: COUNTING CHANNELS
lines: Twelve lifted states give four distinct readings each; another twelve give six.
十二个提升态各有 4 种不同读数，另外十二个各有 6 种。
Two ordered comparisons square each count: twelve times sixteen, plus twelve times thirty-six, makes six hundred twenty-four.
两次有序比较把每个读数个数平方：12 × 16 加 12 × 36，合计 624。
Feed thresholds generated by this model back through an inversion, and the gain lands between 623.91 and 624.09.
把这个模型生成的阈值数据送回去反演，增益落在 623.91 与 624.09 之间。

scenes.name: SEVENTEEN TICKS
lines: Now let the channels travel. Along shell edges of squared length at most fifty-six, two hundred sixteen get stuck.
让通道动起来：只沿平方弦长不超过 56 的整数壳边走，有 216 条被困在孤立单边上。
Route them through a grid that cuts the sphere into thirds, and all of them return in nine steps, the fewest possible.
借道球面三分之一细分格中转，全部通道九步内回程，九步已是下界。
Four hops in, four hops out, nine steps home: a seventeen-tick feedback cycle.
四跳汇合、四跳逆送、九步回程：一个十七拍的反馈周期。
But hold the old shell block fixed and reuse these edges for mass, and every candidate's mass reading goes up.
可一旦固定旧壳传播块、把同样的边拿来传质量，每枚候选的质量读数都被抬高。

scenes.name: TWO HIDDEN MODES
lines: Why are these prices so rigid? Eliminate two hidden modes with a Schur complement.
这些代价为何如此刚硬？用舒尔补消去两个隐藏模式。
The four visible responses become neighbouring products along one chain of couplings.
四个可见响应变成同一条耦合链上相邻两项的乘积。
Lean checks exactly which patterns can occur. If beta and epsilon are nonzero, gamma cannot vanish.
Lean 内核检验了哪些响应模式恰好可能出现：β 与 ε 都非零时，γ 不能为零。

scenes.name: THREE CHANNELS
lines: A second Lean theorem: three channels in parallel, together an exact multiple of an isometry.
第二条 Lean 定理：三支通道并联，合起来恰为等距的常数倍。
Squeeze the left side, b inputs onto fewer outputs a, and the right ratio c over d must drop.
压缩左侧，把 b 维输入压到更少的 a 维输出，右侧的比 c/d 就必须下降。
Two thirds, one half, one third, then nothing past three: a staircase, checked for every dimension.
2/3、1/2、1/3，过了 3 就无解：一座阶梯，对一切维数成立。

scenes.name: MEMORY RANK
lines: Back on the shell: how many hidden memory states reproduce all three clock responses exactly?
回到球壳：要精确复现三个时钟响应，最少需要多少个辅助记忆态？
Freeze the old nineteen-point block, and you need exactly thirty-eight.
冻结旧的十九点传播块，恰好需要 38 个。
Allow edits up to a squared chord cutoff D, and the price falls: twenty-four at three ninety-two, twenty-three at five forty-four.
允许修改平方弦距不超过 D 的旧块条目，代价随之下降：D = 392 时 24，544 时 23。
Then twenty-one, twenty, and a floor of nineteen. These steps are replay certificates, not Lean theorems.
再到 21、20，地板是 19。这些台阶是复算证书，不是 Lean 定理。

scenes.name: HURWITZ CORE
lines: On the input side, couplings are prepared by words in norm-five Hurwitz quaternions.
在输入一侧，耦合由范数五赫维茨四元数的词来制备。
Their bedrock is the twenty-four element unit core: twelve representatives, up to sign.
它们的基石是二十四元单位晶核：模去正负号，剩十二个代表。
Doubled to clear denominators, each has squared norm four. Lean checks this with zero axioms.
坐标加倍消去分母后，每个模方都是 4。Lean 内核在零公理下检验了这一点。
Sixteen-step words reach the coupling box but match no zero; the first single word that matches needs twenty-one.
16 步的词能进耦合盒，却不匹配任何零点；第一条单独匹配的词要 21 步。

scenes.name: WHO WINS
lines: So which Riemann zero does the model choose? It depends on the criterion.
那么模型究竟挑中哪一枚黎曼零点？取决于用哪条准则。
Spectral weight, matching volume, port gain, vacuum energy: each crowns a different zero.
谱权、匹配体积、端口增益、真空能：每条准则都把桂冠戴给不同的零点。
If one unread zero acts on every copy, three copies are exactly enough to protect a qutrit with zero error.
若同一枚未读零点作用于每份副本，三份副本恰好足以零误差保护一个三态量子信息。
Each of these is a model-internal witness. No single law yet selects the zero.
这些都只是模型内的见证；仍没有一条定律能选定那枚零点。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter fourteen.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十四章
